sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
This card can only come in play by using [[OAL-023|The Professor: Organization Founder]] or by using the Exhaust Action, [[OAL-083|Deploy Agent]]. Just like the [[Suits]] within [[the Organization]], these cards may be used to create a whole army.

The beginnings of the Organization included a recruiting drive. From these humble beginnings, the Suit army grew into a much more efficient force. [[OAL-023|The Professor: Organization Founder]] cranks out Suits to like there’s no tomorrow. With just 1 ATK and 1 DEF, these early recruits are not exactly an elite fighting force, but they are plenty useful. They can start combats or block your opponent’s movement. They’re also perfect for taking exhaust actions, leaving your more capable troops to do the fighting. The even can be used as a sacrifice for the [[SAS-029|DeFoe: Organization Lieutenant]] and the [[OAL-019|DeFoe: Out for Revenge]] cards.
